clips.title: The story
paras: At the Lushwater and Stagnant Oases, snapjaws bear altered shells that draw a druid’s attention. Their carapaces may reveal what the fissures beneath the Barrens are doing to local wildlife.

Oasis snapjaws have changed in ways that trouble those who study the land. The freshwater turtles of Lushwater and Stagnant Oases are believed to drink from springs fed by mysterious underground fissures. Their altered carapaces have caught the attention of researchers at the Crossroads. Tonga Runetotem, a tauren druid, gathers the shells as he seeks to understand the land’s health. He wants to learn whether energies rising from deep below are an unnatural blight or something stranger.
